pairs.subject: spatial-audio-scene-authoring
pairs.evidence: src/lib/spatial-audio-generator.ts:14 The room-type profile row that SpatialAudioGeneratorPanel's derivation reads carries its base radius as a bare number with no world unit, and its priority is a 0-10 integer that does not match the event catalog's four-band 0-3 weights, so the table breaks the unit and one-authority rules the technique names.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/spatial-audio-generator.ts:14 The per-room-type table exists (ROOM_ACOUSTICS), and the override/regeneration contract is surfaced in SyncPlanPreview ('hand-tuned ... left as is', per-room overwrite). But the radius is unitless in the authoring row, `priority: number` (0-10) is a second scale beside the catalog's low/normal/high/critical weights, and a room with no keyword match silently gets a type-default emitter (lines 388-394) instead of showing 'no emitters derived'.

src/lib/audio-codegen.ts:353 Inner radius is 30% of the zone radius with a 50uu floor. Codegen then emits a sphere shape, Logarithmic falloff (line 384) and an LPF sweep from 20000 to 2000 Hz between the inner radius and the falloff distance (lines 390-393). The generated comment puts 'uu' beside the radius (line 354).

src/lib/audio-codegen.ts:433 OCCLUSION_VALUES (audio-scene-acoustics.ts:69) keeps volume and cutoff together in one row. But the generated ASceneAudioVolume only declares OcclusionVolumeMultiplier/OcclusionLPFCutoff, and no BeginPlay or ApplyReverbSettings code reads them (grep: they appear only in the declaration and the spawn comment). There is no glide, no hysteresis, and no separate obstruction path.

src/lib/audio-scene-acoustics.ts:17 REVERB_PARAMS is a single authority with the nine presets plus custom and an explicit all-zero 'none', resolved through resolveZoneReverb (ReverbDecayGlyph.tsx imports it). But decay and the two delays are handed on with no unit stated, and the generated ApplyReverbSettings sets Density/Diffusion/DecayTime/LateDelay but never ReflectionsDelay, so early delay (the near-surface cue) never reaches UE.

pairs.registryProposal: occlusion-to-volume-and-filter could name a 'declared-not-wired' failure: a generator emits the ladder's volume and cutoff as engine properties that no runtime code applies, so the table looks conformant while walls do nothing.
